entries.en: dew; (rocío de boca) moisture of the mouth, spittle
entries.notes: rocío de boca 一义仅据西语字面，汉文与闽南语栏只对应「露」。

entries.en: dew; to be wetted by the dew
entries.notes: 西语栏空白，释义依汉文「露」与闽南语 tiam-lou（释作「沾露」）补足。

entries.zh: 噴灑、噴（以口噴出水沫）；霧、細霧
entries.en: to spray or spout with the mouth; mist, fine drizzle
entries.notes: 西语行文严重破损（torlyo. in spirapsibly 不可复原），M 栏首音 [疑:b/ch] 未定，四栏不能互证。

entries.zh: 噴、噴射（液體自口中噴出）
entries.en: to spurt, to spray out (liquid from the mouth)
entries.notes: 西语栏空白，释义据「噴」字与 pun 读音，承接上行 rociar con la boca。
西语栏空白；M 栏 lou-lou-chu 疑为「露」字重出，整体对应「露珠」。

entries.en: to be moistened by the dew, to catch the dew

entries.notes: 「凍露水」与 rocío grande 的对应需推断；M 栏末尾 grande 系西语窜入，非闽南语。

entries.en: to roll, to turn round; (rodar, hacer vuelta) to wheel about
to roll along the road, to wheel along
entries.notes: H 栏第二字 [疑:彝/輾]，M 栏尾字 tiiy 破损；依「車輾轉」与 chia-lin-tiiy 定为车行滚转之义。

entries.en: to turn round, to go around, to circle
to go round, to circle; a wheel turning
to go round; a winding road, a detour
a bend in the road; to go round
to circle back, to turn back round
to turn round, to spin; (rodear con la falda) to skirt around
entries.notes: Rodear con la falda 一句 17 世纪语义未明（falda 可指裙裾或山麓），M 栏混入西语 dar bueltes 且尾部 [残]。
H 栏「腳頭肝」疑为「腳頭趺」之讹；R 栏 cheng cong 系右侧远栏字、归属存疑，未采用。
